# GeoKnight GIS
> GeoKnight GIS (GeoKnight Geospatial Information Services), based in Jacksonville, Florida and serving clients anywhere, builds custom GIS web applications: interactive web maps, dashboards and map-based tools for businesses and government. Pricing: $95–$125/hr; Starter map $350; custom dashboard or tool $1,500–$5,000; data pipelines from $5,000; custom quotes by call, including integrations that connect maps to existing systems (CRM, permitting, asset or work-order systems, databases, APIs and data syncs). Optional monthly hosting add-on: Starter map $50/mo, dashboard or tool from $150/mo, pipelines from $400/mo; setup included when we build it; includes monitoring, backups, security updates and cloud costs up to a set limit, usage above billed at cost plus a small margin; 10% off annual hosting. Founded by Christopher Knight, GIS & Data Engineer.
